name: get_counter_for_gpu_frames
description: Get all GPU metric counters for the given GPU frame time ranges. Provide arrays of start and end times (at least 20 pairs recommended). Get frame timestamps first with run_sql_query: SELECT ts, dur FROM slice WHERE name LIKE 'GPU%' LIMIT 20. If session_id is omitted, uses the most recently captured trace.

end_ts.description: Array of end times of GPU frames in nanoseconds

session_id.description: The file name of the trace (session ID). If omitted, uses the most recently captured trace.

start_ts.description: Array of start times of GPU frames in nanoseconds
